labels: A sleeveless knitted vest frames the shirt collar at its V neck and leaves both shirt sleeves visible through bounded armholes.; 소매 없는 니트 베스트의 V넥이 셔츠 깃을 둘러싸고 양 암홀 밖으로 셔츠 소매가 드러난다.
definition: Complete optional school-life visual realization: A sleeveless knitted vest frames the shirt collar at its V neck and leaves both shirt sleeves visible through bounded armholes.
